nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_1
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment:
Why we compute DeltaSeconds instead of using MetricsUpdateInterval directly

Because timers are not perfect. Even if you requested 0.10 seconds, the actual interval might be 0.11, 0.16, etc. Using real Delta makes:

- stamina regen correct,

- hit windows correct,

-pressure gain/decay correct
